user.title: Camera Hub
user.description: Pick the Frigate cameras to show, and the camera the main view shows by default.

data.return_after_seconds: Return to the default camera after

data_description.return_after_seconds: Seconds without a touch before the main view shows the default camera again. 0 turns this off.

error.default_not_selected: The default camera must be one of the selected cameras.

abort.frigate_missing: Set up the Frigate integration first.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Camera Hub is already set up.

data.return_after_seconds: Return to the default camera after

data_description.return_after_seconds: Seconds without a touch before the main view shows the default camera again. 0 turns this off.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: A zone is a group of cameras that share notifications and pauses. Each burst of alerts in a zone is one phone notification. It shows the camera that saw the person last, except that a priority camera keeps the notification over the zone's other cameras.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Camera Hub sends one notification per burst of person alerts in a zone. In shadow delivery it decides but sends nothing, and fires a camera_hub_decision event for each decision: use it to compare with another notification setup before you switch.

data_description.quiet_window_seconds: A burst ends after this long without a new alert in the zone.
data_description.faces: No notification when every recognised face in an alert belongs to a person who is at home.

doorbell.title: Doorbell
doorbell.description: When the doorbell rings, or a person comes to the door, every Camera Hub card shows the doorbell camera with Talk and Dismiss. Leave the camera empty to turn this off.

data_description.ring: A press always shows the doorbell.
data_description.person: A person shows the doorbell when none is showing and the last one is longer ago than the cooldown.
data_description.tablet_notify: A Home Assistant Companion app on Android, for example mobile_app_kitchen_tablet. Its screen turns on, and it opens the dashboard path.

error.default_not_selected: The default camera must be one of the selected cameras.
error.zone_names: Each zone needs a name, and the names must be different.
error.zone_name_all: "all" is reserved: it means every zone in the pause services.
error.zone_cameras: Each zone needs at least one camera.
error.zone_priority: Priority cameras must also be cameras of the zone.

pause_zone.name: Pause zone notifications
pause_zone.description: Pause the notifications of a zone, or of all zones, for a number of minutes.

resume_zone.name: Resume zone notifications
resume_zone.description: End the pause of a zone, or of all zones.

dismiss_doorbell.name: Dismiss doorbell
dismiss_doorbell.description: End the doorbell takeover on every Camera Hub card.
